flatten_density_profile: flatten a density profile while preserving total particle number during a sawtooth crash
flatten_temperature_profile: flatten a temperature profile while preserving total energy using redistributed density
flatten_current_profile: flatten a poloidal flux profile while preserving total plasma current
get_trial_profile: generate a trial profile shape using linear interpolation at the magnetic axis, q=1 surface, and mixing radius
get_scaling_factor: compute a scaling factor based on volume integral conservation between original and trial profiles
